title: 第005章 姐，你在里面吗？
slug: 醉酒亲错人年下弟弟失控发疯
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

舒楹到家快十一点。

绵绵哭累睡着了，眼角有残余的小珍珠，胳膊上烫伤的痕迹也很明显。

她心里有些不是滋味，总觉得自己的责任更大，不该轻易地把绵绵交给除自己以外的人。

“麻麻……”绵绵闻到熟悉的气息，在睡梦中挣扎着睁开眼，“香香。”

舒楹顺势低头亲了亲她的小脸蛋，“妈妈在这。”

绵绵困得厉害，没一会儿就又进入了梦乡。

反倒是舒楹一晚上都没怎么睡着，天不亮就把行李箱收拾了出来。

她的大件行李走物流寄回来，地址填的余露家里。

随身就两个箱子，她干脆都带去了医院。

许栀意猜到她的意思，难得地没有说什么，开车载着她们往医院赶。

“姐，你昨晚去的是程家的酒会吗？”

途中，许栀意不经意提起了昨晚的活动，“谢亭渝还特地来了一趟，给我爸送酒。”

舒楹没防备她会提起这一茬，分不清是炫耀更多还是单纯分享日常。

昨晚她从谢亭渝车上下来，撑着他给的伞，顶着暮春的冷雨沿着小区走了十来分钟。

她的心也像是浸在了雨里，冰凉、苦涩。

比起那些，许栀意提起谢亭渝时的骄傲与娇俏对她的杀伤力没那么强劲。

“嗯。”舒楹敷衍地点点头，“说明他很在意你们的关系。”

许栀意显然把她的客气当真了，“这点他确实没的说，平时走到哪都会记得给我买礼物。有一次他去外地出差，给我背了一箱子的玩偶回来，加起来都不如他的行李箱贵……”

她持续输出谢亭渝对她的好，舒楹听来仿佛没认识过这个人一般。

谢亭渝比她小五岁，为了维持人设在她面前穿的都是某宝上几十块的t恤牛仔裤。

那会的他远谈不上成熟稳重，没有经济基础哄人的办法也很笨拙。

分手那晚他对她说滚，永远别再出现在她面前。

放狠话的时候嘴硬得厉害，没多久就淋着雨醉醺醺地出现在她家楼下，固执地站了一晚上的岗。

一晃三年过去，他在她这里得到的教训，反馈在了另一个女生身上。

舒楹低头轻声和绵绵说话，掩饰住眼里复杂的情绪，“……是不是坐车头晕了呀宝宝？怎么耷拉着眼睛。”

她装作忙碌，没有继续细聊他们情侣相处的细节。

到了医院，许栀意领着她去了吴主任的诊室。

Page (1/3)

It was almost eleven o'clock when Shu Ying got home.

Mianmian fell asleep after crying. There were small pearls remaining in the corners of her eyes, and the burn marks on her arms were also obvious.

She felt a little uncomfortable in her heart. She always felt that her responsibility was greater and she shouldn't hand over Mianmian to someone other than herself easily.

"Mama..." Mianmian smelled the familiar scent and struggled to open her eyes in her sleep, "Smells fragrant."

Shu Ying lowered his head and kissed her little face, "Mom is here."

Mianmian was very sleepy and soon fell asleep again.

On the contrary, Shu Ying didn't sleep much all night and packed her suitcase before dawn.

Her large luggage was sent back through logistics, and the address she filled in was Yu Lu's home.

She only had two boxes with her and took them to the hospital.

Xu Zhiyi guessed what she meant, and rarely said anything, driving them to the hospital.

"Sister, did you go to the Cheng family's cocktail party last night?"

On the way, Xu Zhiyi casually mentioned last night's activities, "Xie Tingyu even made a special trip to deliver wine to my dad."

Shu Ying was not prepared for her to mention this, and couldn't tell whether it was more about showing off or simply sharing her daily life.

Last night she got off Xie Tingyu's car, held the umbrella he gave her, and walked along the community for about ten minutes in the cold rain of late spring.

Her heart also seemed to be soaked in the rain, cold and bitter.

Compared with those, Xu Zhiyi's pride and coquettishness when she mentioned Xie Tingyu were not so lethal to her.

"Yeah." Shu Ying nodded perfunctorily, "It means he cares about your relationship."

Xu Zhiyi obviously took her politeness seriously, "He really didn't say this. He always remembers to buy me gifts wherever he goes. Once he went on a business trip and brought me back a box of dolls, which together were not as expensive as his suitcase..."

She continued to express Xie Tingyu's kindness to her, and Shu Ying sounded as if she had never known this person before.

Xie Tingyu is five years younger than her, and in order to maintain his persona in front of her, he wears T-shirts and jeans worth tens of dollars from a certain store.

At that time, he was far from mature and stable. He had no financial foundation and his method of coaxing people was very clumsy.

The night they broke up, he told her to get out and never show up in front of her again.

He was very tough when he said harsh words. Not long after, he showed up drunkenly downstairs in her house in the rain and stood stubbornly on guard all night.

Three years later, the lessons he learned from her were reflected on another girl.

Shu Ying lowered her head and spoke softly to Mianmian, hiding the complicated emotions in her eyes, "...Are you dizzy after riding in the car, baby? Why are your eyes drooping?"

She pretended to be busy and did not continue to discuss the details of their relationship as a couple.

When they arrived at the hospital, Xu Zhiyi led her to Director Wu's consulting room.
